#XM

The remaining スリトレ (slang, meaning not established) is left half-finished in the "10,000 yen challenge", so I'll think about what to do with it from here.

Thanks for all this time.
Farewell, high-leverage warriors 🫡

If I had 50,000 yen, maybe a shot at Exness, or the 100% bonus at XM. Which is better?

All those people saying XM is dodgy
have childish logic.

A brokerage is a business too, you know.
It's a customer-service business.

The usage rate of XM among Japanese people is quite high.
They have no reason to carelessly lose good customers.

Build a proper route for deposits and withdrawals yourself,
take solid precautions, and use it.

That's all you need.

If it were only Japanese FX, how boring would that be.

xm follow-up

I emailed xm support several times, and it seems some got through; I just received a reply.
I can't determine which side is responsible for the emails that were lost.
I apologize to those who were made anxious by the posts today that stirred up anxiety.

However, it is fact that the service was down yesterday 10/25 and that chat could not be connected today.
The image is the reply email from xm.

The xm support representative themselves admits: "Live chat support by operators is temporarily unavailable at the moment."

I don't know what the purpose is, but
- "You're getting hysterical and people find you annoying"
- "Chat connects with no problem, aren't you just disliked?"
- "It's operating normally with no problems, and you're the only one making a fuss"
- "It would be better to report this guy"

and others besides, everyone who made insulting remarks about me without verifying the facts has been recorded, and I absolutely will not forgive them.
I will organize all the records from now on and report.

#xm #続報 #海外FX

Let me vent a little 😃

A mutual follower (@seiyasky55) was in trouble with withdrawals and inquiries at the overseas FX broker xm
→ With my motto of "kind to followers, strict to everyone else", I thought I might be able to help somehow
→ Knowing full well that small withdrawals at xm incur a 2,500 yen fee, I submitted a withdrawal request and sent inquiry emails so I could share how it goes in my own case
→ For some reason I was suspected of being connected with xm, unfollowed, and told things like "we'll take legal action, remember this" (see the comment exchanges on this guy's posts lol)
→ I unfollowed, blocked and reported him

And in the meantime I got caught in a USD/JPY short
→ That is entirely my own fault lol

Damn, I'm furious that I paid the 2,500 yen fee for this guy, and on top of that got caught in the USD/JPY short!!!

Because things like this happen, I had been careful to check who the person is before following, even when I got comments or likes.

Still, for mutual followers I regularly interact with, I do want to help if they're in trouble.

Huh? Am I not cut out for social media? lol
